question: Which of the following is one of the main mineral constituents of the continental mass of the earth?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Silica**__.

__
 
• **The main mineral constituents of the continental mass are silica and alumina**__.

 __
 
• It is thus called **sial (si-silica and al-alumina)**.
